derived_envelope_method: abs(prediction-observation) > max(source sigma column 3, source sigma column 4) + systematic_pct * observation / 100; simple descriptive heuristic; not a confidence level; systematic errors can correlate
independent_check: published Gaia DR2 / APOGEE-era rotation curve, not used to calibrate this 233 km/s Gaia DR3-era normalized model, though survey methodologies overlap
critical_caveats: This is external validation of a simplified axisymmetric model, not the exact galpy MWPotential2014 canonical output.
Calibration closure at 8.277 kpc remains by construction; external measurements give meaningful residuals.
Published source table is reproduced by Cautun et al. and may contain asymmetric statistical error columns; the two columns are kept separately rather than misidentified.
Systematic uncertainties are correlated between radial bins; counts outside the envelope do NOT imply a formal hypothesis test or independent Gaussian draws.
Eilers et al. adopted solar galactocentric radius ~8.122 kpc, rather than 8.277 kpc; published radii are compared as-is here without frame rescaling.
The model is only originally sampled 0-8.277 kpc; bins 8.78-24.82 are out-of-corridor predictions from the same analytic potential.
Independent holdout measurements remain separate; no parameters were re-fit to reduce residuals.
No inner <5kpc observational claims are made from Eilers because their study excludes the barred inner region.
